name: When is the best time of year to apply sun-protection exterior paint in the DFW area?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time of year to apply sun-protection exterior paint in the DFW area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best time to apply exterior paint in the DFW area is typically spring or fall. These seasons offer more consistent moderate temperatures (ideally between 50-85°F) and lower humidity, which are crucial for proper paint curing and adhesion. Avoiding the peak summer heat helps prevent issues like premature drying, bubbling, or cracking, ensuring the paint performs as intended and maximizes its sun-protective properties over its lifespan.
acceptedAnswer.description: Spring or fall are ideal for exterior painting in DFW due to moderate temperatures and lower humidity, which aid proper curing.
